name: codex-consultants
description: Use bounded, read-only Agy consultations by default, with explicit OpenCode or multi-provider panels and durable review jobs while Codex remains the primary investigator and implementer.

interface.shortDescription: Read-only Agy and OpenCode reviews with job controls
interface.longDescription: Run bounded Agy reviews from Codex by default, or explicitly choose OpenCode and multi-provider panels. Agy receives prioritized evidence from a secret-filtered disposable repository snapshot over stdin and returns structured results without blanket tool approval; provider jobs use isolated sandboxes, bounded context preflight, atomic repository-scoped state, background execution, status/result/cancel controls, and adversarial prompts while Codex independently validates findings, makes changes, and runs tests.
defaultPrompt: Start a background adversarial Agy review and inspect its result.
